days.drive: TIV → Vrmac tunnel / Kotor → M-1 to Risan / Lipci → M-8 via Grahovo → M-7 to Nikšić → M-3 to Jasenovo Polje → M-6 via Šavnik → Runolist Chalet · nominal 3 h 20 min / 4 h adjusted (+20%); live route controls

morning.text: Confirmed EL AL flight LY5467: depart TLV at 11:50 and arrive TIV at 13:50 on Oct 1 (PNR 5682367).
Landing at 13:50 leaves only 40 minutes before the 14:30 pickup. Go directly to the Arrivals desk and call Europcar at +382 20 653141 if delayed.

Europcar voucher 4H419663: pickup at Tivat Airport at 14:30; Europcar desk is in Arrivals and the car is at the airport. Rental booking total €362 (paid); class IGAR automatic crossover, Skoda Karoq or similar.

Voucher refs: Flexible Autos 4H419663 / Europcar 1207623276. The €1,154 IGAR deposit requires a physical Visa, Mastercard or AmEx credit card in the main driver’s name; debit, virtual, prepaid and cash are not accepted. Bring original passport, licence, international driving permit and voucher.

IGAR supplier excess is €1,089 (tax treatment per rental terms). Flexible Autos Excess Refund reimburses eligible claims; it is not an Europcar excess waiver and does not remove the deposit. The separate policy lists tires/wheels and undercarriage for reimbursement subject to terms, but excludes off-road/untarmacked and negligent driving; do not buy duplicate counter cover without checking terms.
After the 14:30 voucher pickup, aim to leave around 15:15–15:30 only if landing, rental collection, driver and live road/weather checks are all on track.

afternoon.text: Drive directly north to your Runolist Chalet via the Vrmac tunnel and Kotor, then M-1 to Risan/Lipci, M-8 via Grahovo, M-7 to Nikšić, M-3 to Jasenovo Polje and M-6 via Šavnik.
Check live navigation for closures or reroutes.
Use 3 h 20 min as a nominal published estimate; current sources vary and live traffic/weather can extend it, then add 20%: about 4 h adjusted, before traffic or stops.
That points to roughly 19:15–19:30 arrival.
Žabljak sunset on Oct 1 is about 18:26 and civil twilight ends about 18:55, so this deliberately breaks the usual daylight cutoff.
Do not add the Lepetane ferry, viewpoints, a swim, or a meal stop.

If the flight or rental is delayed, visibility/weather is poor, roads are restricted, or the driver is tired, stay at your stop safely and arrange lodging directly; resume only after a fresh road/weather and driver check and coordination with Runolist.
If conditions deteriorate after you leave, do not press on: stop at the next safe town, arrange lodging and secure the bags.

evening.text: Check in and unload every bag.
Eat near the lodging or use food arranged ahead.

Runolist confirmation 5203973379: Two-Bedroom House for 2 adults; check-in Oct 1, 14:00–24:00. Total €225.39, cash-only at the property; paid amount/balance is not stated. Free cancellation through Sep 29, 2026 23:59 CEST, then €219.39; no-show fee same. Tell the host your arrival time in advance; +382 69 520 016.

days.parking: Runolist Chalet, Narodnih heroja, 84220 Žabljak. Booking.com listing indicates free private parking and shared kitchen access; confirm the booked unit’s access with the host. Booking 5203973379; cash-only payment at property, payment status/balance due not stated.
days.cash: Keep up to €225.39 in cash available for Runolist until the already-paid amount is confirmed. Car rental €362 is paid; Europcar requires a physical Visa, Mastercard or AmEx credit card in the main driver’s name for a €1,154 deposit (fuel/extras may require more).

days.drive: Runolist → Black Lake → P14/R-16 over Sedlo → Trsa → Plužine/Piva → (live choice: M-3 via Nikšić and Šavnik, or return over Sedlo) → Runolist · ~5 h 48 adjusted planning estimate; 6 h ceiling and daylight gates

morning.text: Breakfast at Runolist; leave by 06:30 with water and a packed lunch. Fill the tank and download the P14 map before leaving town.
Park at the signed Black Lake lot by about 06:50. The full shore loop is about 3.6 km; allow up to 90 minutes for the walk and photos, then leave by 08:30.
Walk the Black Lake shore loop at an easy pace. The small-lake shore can be damp and slippery; use grippy shoes and turn back if footing or visibility worsens.
Espresso stop at Gradska Kafanica only if open when you pass; local listing shows 08:00, so confirm the prior evening. If closed, use coffee packed at Runolist.

Continue on P14/R-16 over Sedlo to Trsa, then descend to Plužine for the Piva viewpoint and town. Roads are paved but narrow, winding two-way mountain roads; use signed pullouts and expect to wait for passing places.
Before committing to P14, check AMSCG road conditions, the Sedlo forecast and the host’s local report. Proceed on the primary route if open, dry enough and free of ice/low cloud.

afternoon.text: At Plužine, prioritize the Piva viewpoint and a short lakeside/town stop. Do not add Mratinje Dam or the cheese-farm detour.

Use the packed lunch by default. Restoran Piva Lake is the corridor sit-down option only if called ahead and the live return estimate remains within 6 h adjusted; allow 60 minutes, confirm parking and carry cash because payment is unverified.

Choose the return live: use M-3 via Nikšić and M-6 via Šavnik only if navigation keeps total adjusted driving ≤6 h and the Žabljak return target by 16:00. Otherwise return over Sedlo if that is the faster safe open route.

Hard decision gate in Plužine: if either return option misses the 6 h driving ceiling or leaves too little buffer before the 17:30 no-mountain-driving cutoff, shorten the stop and start back immediately; do not extend the loop.

Use marked parking only. Black Lake off-season parking is reported at €1.20/hour from Oct 1–May 31; carry coins and confirm the meter/sign. Budget Durmitor admission at the current €5/person rate if charged.

evening.text: Return to Runolist by the 16:00 target and never continue mountain driving beyond 17:30.
Dinner at Zlatni Papagaj, which publishes 18:00–23:00 service and Montenegrin dishes; call/reserve for Oct 2, ask about payment, and walk from the chalet if practical.
Shop at Aroma 311 before closing for Saturday water/snacks; do not add a morning provisioning stop.

days.parking: Use signed Black Lake parking and marked pullouts only; do not stop on P14 blind bends. The Black Lake lot is reported at €1.20/hour off-season (Oct–May); payment type and current sign must be checked. Download the P14/R-16 map before departure.
days.cash: For two: Durmitor admission up to €10 if separately charged, Black Lake parking roughly €1.20/hour/car, optional Plužine meal at unverified price/payment. Carry small EUR notes and coins; packed lunch is the no-delay default.

days.region: North · Tara Canyon / Mojkovac / Kolašin / Biogradska Gora
days.drive: Runolist → conditional Žabljak-side Tara viewpoint/zipline access → Mojkovac → Kolašin → Biogradsko Lake → Kolašin/Mojkovac → Runolist · ~5 h 30 adjusted planning allowance; live route must avoid the closed bridge and remain ≤6 h

morning.text: Breakfast at Runolist and leave around 06:45. Check AMSCG, weather, park access and the Tara operator before setting out; fill the tank and carry water/snacks.

Tara Bridge is scheduled to be closed through Oct 26, 2026. Do not cross the bridge or enter the works. Visit the bridge/canyon only from a safe public viewing place whose access is confirmed open; the map pin is an approximate reference, not parking.

Zipline is a conditional add-on: October dates depend on weather. Red Rock requires walking back across the bridge, so do not use it during this closure. Consider Yellow/Extreme only if the operator confirms operation, retrieval and access without crossing; skip it if it adds delay or breaks either route gate.

Continue toward Kolašin only on a live, paved route that does not cross the closed bridge. Route via the R-10/Mojkovac corridor if navigation confirms it is open; do not accept an unverified gravel shortcut.
Take espresso at Caffe Select in central Kolašin; the Tourism Organisation lists 07:00 winter-season opening, so confirm October hours by phone.

afternoon.text: From Kolašin follow signed park access to Biogradsko Lake; confirm the gate and private-car access before leaving town. The official 2026 notice confirms the season opened, but not Oct 3 road or visitor-train operation.
Walk the lake shore loop, allowing up to 2 hours for the circuit, photos and damp autumn footing. Turn back if the trail is slippery or visibility deteriorates.

On the return corridor, stop at Dobre Vode in Sjerogošte for a 60-minute late lunch: local kačamak, gotovac, lamb in milk and veal under sač. The Tourism Organisation places it on the Kolašin–Mojkovac road, 6 km from the park, with a large car park. Call first for October operation and payment.

Keep adjusted driving at or below 6 h and target Runolist by 16:00, with 17:30 the no-mountain-driving cutoff. If the Tara spur/zipline threatens either limit, skip that spur first and continue the Kolašin/Biogradska primary day.

Biogradska Gora admission is currently €4/person/day; boats are €10/hour, kayaks €3 single / €5 double per hour. The park tariff does not state payment method; carry cash. Confirm October operations before budgeting boat time.

evening.text: Return to Runolist by 16:00 target and stop mountain driving by 17:30.
Dinner at Zlatni Papagaj, 18:00–23:00 published; call/reserve for Oct 3 and ask about payment.
Use the short town walk only after parking at Runolist; keep the late evening restful before the Oct 4 transfer.

days.parking: At Tara, use only confirmed public marked viewpoint and parking, never the road shoulder or work zone. In Kolašin use signed town parking; at Biogradska Gora follow the park checkpoint and same-day vehicle-access instructions. Do not assume summer visitor trains operate in October.
days.cash: For two: Biogradska admission €8; optional boat €10/hour or double kayak €5/hour; possible Tara zipline €40–€90/couple only if operator confirms a bridge-free line and current price. Restaurant, parking and zipline payment methods require confirmation; carry small notes.

Check road/weather notices before rolling; never route across Đurđevića Tara Bridge, which is closed through Oct 26 at noon.

Itemized cancellation terms: free through Sep 28, 2026 23:59 CEST, then €261/no-show; the confirmation intro has conflicting wording. Park at a signed Perast entrance lot; old town is closed to vehicles May–October. Call +382 67 257 387 about pickup availability; don’t assume it.
Do not add a Kotor stop while luggage is in the car.
The individual booking allows check-in 15:00–21:00. After parking and unloading, contact reception and check in; Conte’s reception/property pin does not identify the booked room entrance.

days.drive: Perast ↔ selected Bay / Skadar outing · live route controls; allow about 3 h 30–4 h adjusted for Virpazar round trip

morning.text: Choose one outing; do not try to cram all three into the last full day.
For Skadar, leave Perast around 08:00 for Virpazar.
The scenic route uses R-1 toward Njeguši/Cetinje, then R-15; the coastal option is M-1 through Budva and Petrovac, M-1.1 through the tolled Sozina Tunnel, then M-2/R-15.
Follow live routing around works and weather.
Book a boat only after the operator confirms an October departure and return time.
The park lists €5/person/day and says one cruise is included; verify that it covers your chosen trip.
Old €10 group / €50 private fares are traveler history, not quotes.

afternoon.text: On the Skadar option, be ashore by 15:45.
Eat in Virpazar.
Add a Godinje winery only with a reservation.
Choose a sober driver for the winery stop.
For Perast, park at the signed lot.
Walk the old lanes.
Take the island boat only if it is running.
Budva/Sveti Stefan is the beach-and-old-town alternative.
Traffic and parking can eat the afternoon; skip Budva if crowds annoy you.
Return to Conte in Perast before dark.

evening.text: Have the final dinner in Perast.
Leave bags at Conte Hotel & Restaurant.
Keep tomorrow’s airport run simple and predictable.
